acceptance_criteria: outcome-write-failure and orphan-surfacing cases; CHK-08, CHK-12, NEG-08, NEG-13.
statement: After the callback returns an explicit outcome, the journal **shall** durably append and sync an outcome frame; if the outcome append or sync fails, the API **shall** report `EvidenceIncomplete` and **shall** not report success, and a recovery scan **shall** surface the intent as an orphan until an explicit resolution outcome is written.
title: T026 requirement 006
